clean_room.0: Set a 5-min timer and only pick up the dirty clothes from the floor, into the hamper (nothing else)
clean_room.1: Pick up the clean clothes lying around and pile them on the bed (don't fold yet)
clean_room.2: Grab cups, plates, or visible trash and take them out of the room (to the kitchen or the bin)
clean_room.3: Clear only the nightstand: anything that isn't from there goes in a "homeless" box
clean_room.4: Clear only the desk the same way: everything that isn't from there goes in the same "homeless" box
clean_room.5: Make the bed (smooth the sheets, fluff the pillows)
clean_room.6: Fold the pile of clean clothes on the bed and put them away in the closet/drawers
clean_room.7: Go through the "homeless" box: put each item in its place, one by one, without overthinking
clean_room.8: Do a quick sweep with a trash bag (papers, wrappers) and take it out
clean_room.9: Take one full look around the room and fix anything left out of place at a glance
clean_room.10: Reward — treat yourself to something nice (drink, cookie, favorite snack) and sit for 5 min enjoying the tidy room

make_cv.0: Open a blank document and title it "CV - [your name]"
make_cv.1: Write your contact info at the top (name, email, phone, city)
make_cv.2: Create the empty sections: Experience, Education, Skills (Projects if it applies)
make_cv.3: In "Education", quickly jot down institution + degree + year, no pretty formatting
make_cv.4: In "Experience", list each job/placement as a loose bullet with 1 line (what you did, not how it reads)
make_cv.5: Pick 1 job and turn its bullet into a sentence with a concrete result (e.g. "increased X by Y%")
make_cv.6: Repeat the previous step with each remaining experience, one by one
make_cv.7: In "Skills", list everything that comes to mind without filtering (you trim later)
make_cv.8: Read it straight through once, marking what's extra or sounds off (don't fix it yet)
make_cv.9: Delete/adjust only what you marked, save the file as PDF
make_cv.10: Reward — treat yourself to a snack or drink and send the CV to someone you trust to look at it (or just celebrate)

monthly_budget.0: Open your bank app and write down your current balance (just that number)
monthly_budget.1: Write down your approximate monthly income (salary, allowance, whatever comes in)
monthly_budget.2: Open your credit card (if you have one) and write down the current debt
monthly_budget.3: List the fixed expenses you already know by heart: rent, phone plan, subscriptions
monthly_budget.4: Add up all the fixed expenses from step 3
monthly_budget.5: Subtract fixed expenses from your monthly income → that's your "free money"
monthly_budget.6: Quickly scan last month's card/account activity, no analyzing, just scan
monthly_budget.7: Write down 3 categories where you spent more than you expected
monthly_budget.8: Set a weekly limit for those 3 categories (a number, don't overthink it)
monthly_budget.9: Save it all in a simple note or spreadsheet — it doesn't need to look professional, it just needs to exist
monthly_budget.10: Reward — pour yourself something nice and spend 2 minutes looking at something you want to buy with the money you "found"
